items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: you would meet people like Bob Hope

ctx.x: And State, about four, five doors from the corner. Now, when the club first opened up, it opened up as a bar, and they had a band sitting up in the little balcony playing. So that was the beginning. And then they just added another part onto it, next -- in the lot next to it. And this started the Del-sa, and the further back you'd

go, the lower the ceiling would get. So you ended up bending down. And that was another high point, because the musicians used to come, like, every Monday morning for the breakfast show and all the performers from all over the city -- you don't know, you would meet people like Bob Hope, and then Buddy Rich was talking about it in his article. And you just didn't know who you would meet in there. All the musicians from all of the things, and then, way in the back back there they used to get in the back and the…
So it was just that wild, and they didn't pay any attention to it, nobody said anything. So --
